value: This article details Arc's Mini Player (Picture-in-Picture) and Audio Player features, available on macOS and Windows, designed to enhance multitasking by allowing users to continue consuming multimedia content while browsing. The Mini Player for videos automatically appears or can be manually activated, is resizable, and can be disabled on a per-site basis. Similarly, the Audio Player automatically displays a controller in the sidebar for audio content. Both features facilitate uninterrupted media enjoyment, with the caveat that they will not activate if the original media tab is muted.
